records.Name: Password reset emails delayed for Outlook.com addresses
records.Summary__c: Password reset emails to Outlook.com and Hotmail addresses can take up to an hour to arrive.
records.Workaround__c: Add noreply@nimbus.example to your safe senders, or ask your admin to send the reset link from the admin console.

records.Name: Two-factor codes rejected after changing the phone's time zone
records.Summary__c: After the password, authenticator codes are rejected at login when the phone's clock or time zone was changed manually.
records.Workaround__c: Turn on automatic date and time on the phone, then sign in again.

records.Name: Login loop on Safari when cross-site tracking is blocked
records.Summary__c: Safari users with Prevent Cross-Site Tracking on were sent back to the login page after entering their password.
records.Workaround__c: Fixed in the March release. Clear the browser cache if it still happens.

records.Name: New password not accepted by Atlas Mobile until the next sign-in
records.Summary__c: After a password change, Atlas Mobile keeps asking for the old password until you sign out and in again.
records.Workaround__c: Sign out of Atlas Mobile and sign in with the new password.

records.Name: Locked out after five failed password attempts on SSO accounts
records.Summary__c: Reported: SSO users are locked out by password attempts they never made. Not confirmed yet.

records.Name: Invoice PDF shows the old company address
records.Summary__c: Invoices generated after an address change still show the previous address on the PDF.
records.Workaround__c: Download the invoice again after 24 hours; the PDF is regenerated overnight.

records.Name: Duplicate invoice emails for annual plans
records.Summary__c: Customers on annual plans received the renewal invoice email twice.
records.Workaround__c: Fixed. Only one invoice was charged; the second email can be ignored.

records.Name: Invoice totals rounded differently in the CSV export
records.Summary__c: Totals in the invoice CSV export can differ by one cent from the PDF because of rounding.
records.Workaround__c: Use the PDF amount for accounting; the export will match after the fix.

records.Name: Invoice download times out for accounts with many invoices
records.Summary__c: The invoice list fails to load for accounts with more than 500 invoices.
records.Workaround__c: Filter the list by year before downloading.

records.Name: Tax missing on invoices for new EU customers
records.Summary__c: Reported: VAT is missing on the first invoice of some new EU accounts. Not confirmed yet.

records.Name: Offline edits lost when the app is closed during sync
records.Summary__c: Changes made offline can be lost if Atlas Mobile is closed while it is syncing them.
records.Workaround__c: Keep the app open until the sync icon disappears. Version 5.3 fixes this.

records.Name: Photos attached offline upload twice
records.Summary__c: Photos added to a record while offline were uploaded twice after reconnecting.
records.Workaround__c: Fixed in 5.2. Delete the duplicate photo from the record.

records.Name: Sync stalls at 99% on Android 15
records.Summary__c: On some Android 15 devices the first sync after an update never finishes.
records.Workaround__c: Restart the app, or turn off battery optimization for Atlas Mobile.

records.Name: Battery drain from background sync on iOS
records.Summary__c: Background sync used more battery than expected on iOS 19.
records.Workaround__c: Fixed in 5.1.

records.Name: Calendar sync duplicates recurring events
records.Summary__c: Recurring events edited on the phone appear twice in the web calendar.
records.Workaround__c: Edit recurring events in the web app until the fix ships.

records.Name: Dashboard charts blank after the April release
records.Summary__c: Some dashboards show empty charts since the April release when a filter uses a date range.
records.Workaround__c: Remove and re-add the date filter, or use a relative range such as Last 30 days.

records.Name: Scheduled report emails an hour late after the clock change
records.Summary__c: Scheduled reports were sent an hour late after daylight saving time started.
records.Workaround__c: Fixed. Schedules use your time zone again.

records.Name: Map chart shows the wrong region for some postcodes
records.Summary__c: A few postcodes are placed in a neighbouring region on map charts.
records.Workaround__c: Group by city instead of postcode for now.

records.Name: CSV export drops leading zeros
records.Summary__c: Values such as 00123 lose their leading zeros when a report is exported to CSV.
records.Workaround__c: Export to Excel instead, which keeps the values as text.

records.Name: Dashboard filters reset when sharing a link
records.Summary__c: Reported: filters are lost when a dashboard link is opened by another user. Not confirmed yet.

records.Name: Data import rejects UTF-8 files with a byte order mark
records.Summary__c: CSV files saved with a byte order mark (BOM) failed to import.
records.Workaround__c: Fixed. Files with or without a BOM import correctly.

records.Name: File uploads over 2 GB fail
records.Summary__c: Uploading a single file larger than 2 GB stops at 99%.
records.Workaround__c: Split the file, or use the desktop sync client, which isn't affected.

records.Name: Search misses files renamed today
records.Summary__c: Files renamed in the last few hours were not found by their new name.
records.Workaround__c: Fixed. The search index updates within minutes again.

records.Name: New subfolders don't inherit shared folder permissions
records.Summary__c: Subfolders created inside a shared folder are private to their creator.
records.Workaround__c: Share the subfolder again from the folder's Share menu.

records.Name: API rate limit errors during nightly backups
records.Summary__c: Backup tools hit API rate limits on large accounts between 1 and 3 AM UTC.
records.Workaround__c: Spread backups over the night, or ask support for a temporary limit increase.

records.Name: Notification emails show raw HTML in some email apps
records.Summary__c: Some email apps showed the HTML code of notification emails instead of the message.
records.Workaround__c: Fixed. Notifications include a plain-text version.

records.Name: Admin console slow for large teams
records.Summary__c: The users page in the admin console takes up to 30 seconds to load for teams over 2,000 users.
records.Workaround__c: Search for a user by name instead of scrolling the full list.

records.Name: Workspace invite links expire too early
records.Summary__c: Reported: invite links stop working after a few hours instead of 7 days. Not confirmed yet.
